title: Monster holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M62 44 Q58 56 66 66' stroke='#cfd8ff' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='30' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff5f8f'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='25' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ffa8c4'/>
  <polygon points='60,45 64,45 62,48' fill='#d63a6b'/>

  <ellipse cx='42' cy='73' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#5ed86b'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='80' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#a8f2a0'/>

  <ellipse cx='31' cy='92' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#3aa84a'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='92' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#3aa84a'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <path d='M60 66 Q70 60 66 50' stroke='#5ed86b' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M24 68 Q14 62 16 56' stroke='#5ed86b' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <polygon points='30,56 26,44 36,52' fill='#ffcf4d'/>

  <circle cx='34' cy='66' r='5' fill='#fff9e0'/>

  <circle cx='35' cy='67' r='2.4' fill='#2b3a6b'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='67' r='2.4' fill='#2b3a6b'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M35 78 Q42 86 49 78 Q42 82 35 78 Z' fill='#b02a5a'/>
  <!-- little tooth -->
  <polygon points='39,78 42,78 40.5,82' fill='#fff9e0'/>
</svg>
